description: Blind cross-rule acceptance test for deployed reviewer v4; no answer key, no private or previous comic assets.
testing_notes: One page image and one selected rule per call; focus_rules contains only target_rule; no other rules scored. Exact expected dialogue/speaker from the case manifest. Some test cases were previously evaluated in v3 or the independent illustration reviewer; treat this as a v4 functional regression test, not a novel independent holdout.
